external_evaluation.note: External paired counts remain tar-packaged under per-file embargo; no external outcomes were inspected to define this protocol.

cohort.exclusions: none beyond the H5AD retained set; no donor is removed for outcome reasons

atac.rule: per outer fold, top-256 exact intervals by that fold's training-library prevalence; ties broken by (chromosome, start, end)
atac.no_zero_fill: counts are measured on the union once and subset per fold; unmeasured intervals are never zero-filled

rna.rule: all genes; training-only variance selection to the feature budget inside each fold

donor_splits.inner_validation: one 3-fold donor split on each outer training set, base_seed = outer split_seed

primary_contrast.estimate: mean across repeats of each repeat's donor-level delta (every repeat tests all 30 donors once)
primary_contrast.margin_rule: practical_margin(15, 15); not lowered after seeing results
primary_contrast.advantage_rule: estimate >= margin AND lower 95% donor-bootstrap bound > 0

uncertainty.method: donor-cluster percentile bootstrap over the across-repeat mean
uncertainty.failed_replicates: single-class donor draws counted, never redrawn

seed_dimensions.split_seed: controls donor assignment (5 repeats); not an initialization seed

unresolved: normalization is raw-count standard scaling; the accepted normalization is not separately frozen
external paired RNA+ATAC counts were not accessed
